name: cmb
description: Concurrent Multi-pass Bot (cmb), Craig's personal toolkit. cmb:audit runs a multi-dimensional, parallel codebase audit and returns a 0-10 scorecard per dimension with a severity-ranked list of findings, persisted to .cmb/audit/ so the next run can diff what's fixed, new, or still open. cmb:fix reads those findings and applies the fixes the user picks. cmb:triage records per-finding decisions (plan / accept-risk / dismiss) in .cmb/decisions.json so suppressed items stop re-nagging.
